name: Zholsuchus
isnote: Possibly a goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylian; known only from a premaxilla, and a 2000 review (Storrs and Efimov) is cited for its status (English Wikipedia).
sum: Zholsuchus is a crocodyliform known only from a premaxilla from the Turonian Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan, possibly a goniopholidid.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A right premaxilla from the Bissekty Formation, Dzharakhuduk, Uzbekistan (Nessov et al. 1989); Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: The premaxilla; PBDB also lists occurrences in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Nesov et al. 1989

sources.text: G. W. Storrs and M. B. Efimov. 2000. Mesozoic crocodyliforms of north-central Eurasia. The Age of Dinosaurs in Russia and Mongolia
